data.name: BPI Products training
data.delivery: Logix Computer Academy teaches BPI-authorised courses under a cooperation agreement; BPI retains software and specialist support. Start June 12, 1978.

introduced.event_name: BPI training and direct sales begin

data.availability_note: BPI courses and direct sales begin June 12, 1978, after the NCC premiere; this is separate from the March Academy establishment and June 5 five-city public announcement.
